conventions.part_coordinates: STL, STEP, bbox_mm, centre_of_mass_mm and geometry are in the component coordinates as modelled. This is not the print orientation.
conventions.component_to_world: row-major 4x4, world = M * part, translation in mm
conventions.mass_g_solid: volume times material density, i.e. 100 % infill; a real print is lighter
conventions.interference: overlaps of at least 1.0 mm3 between bodies visible in the model; these are the intended press fits
conventions.cylinder_turn: face area over the area of a full cylinder of that length; below 0.9 it is a fillet or a partial arc, not a bore or a journal
conventions.one_file_one_body: every part is a single closed body; the export refuses a multi-body component
conventions.face_id: BRepFace.tempId in Fusion: unique within a part, valid for this export only
conventions.face_planes: planes of at least 20 mm2; normal points out of the material, centre_mm is the area centroid
conventions.face_mates: neighbours within touching_mm of that face, over all instances of the part: `instance` is the instance of this part, `occurrence` the neighbour. Tools hidden in the model are not counted.

face_function.thread: root or crest cylinder of a thread; its axis is also in threads[].axis
face_function.bearing_seat: cylinder within 0.15 mm of a bearing ring and of its diameter: a journal matches the bore, a housing bore the outside
face_function.taper: cone of at most 15 deg half angle against another printed part
face_function.heat_set_insert_hole: hole (turn of at least 0.5) with a heat-set insert in it
face_function.screw_hole: hole (turn of at least 0.5) with a fastener in it
face_function.spline: one of at least 6 coaxial partial cylinders of one diameter against a printed part
face_function.mating: touches something else; the only non-free value a plane can have
face_function.small: cylinder or cone under 20 mm2 that is also thinner than 2.8 mm or under 5 mm2 (belt tooth arc, tiny fillet): not checked against the neighbours, its `mates` is null

conventions.loads: gravity_in_part is world -Y in part coordinates. belt_pull_in_part (housings only) points from the driven pulley towards the motor pulley: the bearing seats are pulled that way, the motor mount the opposite way. belt_pull_turns_relative_to_part marks the parts that turn with the driven axis and so see that pull from every side.
conventions.fits_bed: the bounding box along the component axes fits the bed in some axis-aligned orientation
conventions.filament: material and PrusaSlicer filament preset per colour, as named by the user
conventions.print_down_in_part: intended direction towards the bed, in part coordinates; null where undecided
